context: Add SF10 and SF100 rungs for the local engines that can hold them (DuckDB, DataFusion, Polars, ClickHouse local) before spending cloud trial credits, so the harness is proven at scale on free compute first. Cloud SF100 is covered by first-live-cloud-benchmark-run-and-publish. Check the datagen and disk budget before committing to SF100 across the full benchmark set - scope to TPC-H and TPC-DS rather than all 19 benchmarks.
